stemMd: A quantity doubles every 4 hours. Starting from 7 units, what is its value after 12 hours?
explanationMd: Twelve hours contain three four-hour intervals. Three doublings multiply the initial quantity by 2³ = 8, giving 7 × 8 = 56. Count growth intervals before applying the exponential factor.

distractorRationale.b: This treats exponential doubling as a linear threefold increase.
distractorRationale.d: This multiplies the initial value by hours rather than growth factors.
distractorRationale.e: This applies four doublings instead of three.
